Antec C8 ARGB Full Tower Case Specifications

The Antec C8 ARGB is a high-performance member of the Constellation series, featuring a dual-chamber layout designed for superior thermal management and a clean aesthetic. With seamless tempered glass on the front and side, it provides a panoramic "fish-tank" view of your components, enhanced by pre-installed ARGB cooling.

Core Specifications

  • Case Type: Full Tower

  • Dimensions: 464 x 303 x 476 mm (DWH)

  • Materials: Steel, Plastic, Tempered Glass

  • Motherboard Support: E-ATX (up to 280mm), ATX, Micro-ATX, ITX

  • Chassis Design: Dual Chamber (separates PSU/Cables from CPU/GPU)

Cooling & Fans

  • Front: Seamless Tempered Glass (No fan support)

  • Top: 3 x 120mm / 3 x 140mm / 2 x 160mm

  • Side: 3 x 120mm / 2 x 140mm

  • Bottom: 3 x 120mm / 3 x 140mm / 2 x 160mm

  • Rear: 1 x 120mm / 1 x 140mm

  • ARGB Features: Includes pre-installed high-airflow ARGB fans and a built-in fan/LED controller.

Radiator Support

  • Top: Up to 360mm

  • Side: Up to 360mm

  • Bottom: Up to 360mm
